name: What can go wrong during a commercial remodel?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong during a commercial remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common issues include permit delays, hidden structural or utility problems, material lead times, scope changes, and coordination conflicts between trades. The best protection is a detailed scope, realistic contingency planning, and regular updates when field conditions differ from the original plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial remodels can run into permit delays, hidden site issues, material shortages, and change orders. A detailed scope and contingency plan reduce surprises.
